seo.title: Pricing | Setu Technology Plans for Every Business
seo.description: Pricing for Setu QR Menu, plus every free Setu product — the Browser Based POS, Free Dine, the Bank Statement Analyzer and more. Free forever, no signup.

hero.headline: Priced per business, not per outlet
hero.subheadline: Most of what we build is free forever, with no signup. Setu QR Menu is the one paid product, priced per business — and free for your first year.

billingNote: All prices are per business account and include GST. Yearly billing is charged once for twelve months.

items.question: Which Setu products are free?
items.answer: All of them except Setu QR Menu. The Browser Based POS, Free Dine, the Bank Statement Analyzer, the Tuition Class Manager and the Free Clinic Manager are free forever, need no signup, and keep your data on your device. Every calculator and tool on the site is free too.

items.question: Is pricing per outlet or per business?
items.answer: Per business account. One Setu QR Menu plan covers your whole business, however many outlets or staff logins you run, so growing does not change what you pay.

items.question: Do the prices include GST?
items.answer: Yes. Every price shown is inclusive of GST, so the amount you see is the amount you pay. There is no separate tax added at checkout.

items.question: What happens after the free year on Setu QR Menu ends?
items.answer: You pick monthly or yearly billing. Nothing is charged during the first year, and we tell you before anything is charged after it.

items.question: When can I buy Setu Dine or Setu Queue?
items.answer: Both are still in development, so they are not on sale and there is no pricing to quote yet. Their product pages list everything they will do — tell us what you run and we will get in touch when they launch. Free Dine is the restaurant till you can use today, free forever.
